reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Nebraska
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Whether the law specifies a minimum number of days a tenant can be late on rent
              before the landlord can file an eviction action for nonpayment.
*/

/* ------------------------- Scenario encoding ------------------------- */

% Scenario metadata (facts)
scenario_state(nebraska).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_issue(min_days_late_before_filing_eviction_nonpayment).

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded scenario statement holds.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(nebraska),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_issue(min_days_late_before_filing_eviction_nonpayment).

/* ------------------------- Statute translations ------------------------- */

% NE Code  76-1431(2) (2021):
% "If rent is unpaid when due and the tenant fails to pay rent within seven calendar days
% after written notice by the landlord of nonpayment and his or her intention to terminate
% the rental agreement if the rent is not paid within that period of time, the landlord may
% terminate the rental agreement."
statute_ne_76_1431_2_cure_period_days(Year, 7) :-
    integer(Year),
    Year =:= 2021.

% Deterministic legal rule: minimum statutory cure/late period (in days) after written notice
% for a nonpayment-based termination that would support an eviction filing.
%
% Note: The statute sets the minimum "within seven calendar days after written notice" period.
% This is treated here as the minimum days threshold the law specifies before the landlord can
% proceed toward eviction for nonpayment (i.e., after proper notice and expiration).
legal_min_days_late_before_eviction_action(State, Year, Days) :-
    State == nebraska,
    statute_ne_76_1431_2_cure_period_days(Year, Days),
    !.

/* ------------------------- Reasoning helpers ------------------------- */

% The question is whether the law specifies a minimum number of days (a numeric threshold)
% before filing an eviction action for nonpayment.
%
% We answer "yes" if there exists a statutorily specified minimum days threshold for nonpayment
% that is relevant to proceeding (termination -> eviction filing path).
law_specifies_min_days_threshold_for_nonpayment_eviction(State, Year, Days) :-
    legal_min_days_late_before_eviction_action(State, Year, Days),
    integer(Days),
    Days > 0,
    !.

/* ------------------------- Final answer ------------------------- */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    law_specifies_min_days_threshold_for_nonpayment_eviction(State, Year, _Days),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

/* ------------------------- Main entrypoint ------------------------- */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law specify a minimum number of days a tenant can be late on rent before the landlord can file an eviction action for nonpayment?
